about: What people say in cantinas: one line per visit, the ones about the captain's own doings first.

rumour.neon_coffee.text: A Neon woke up after thirty years asleep, asked for coffee at the old price and got it. Nobody wanted to be the one to explain.
rumour.neon_coffee.title: Rumour: neon coffee

rumour.drums_at_night.text: The farm drums at Barnard's Star are harvesting at night again. The Sowers say the crop prefers it.
rumour.drums_at_night.title: Rumour: drums at night

rumour.grey_hat_fines.text: A Grey Hat at the bar offers to delete your parking fines. You do not have parking fines. He offers to add some.
rumour.grey_hat_fines.title: Rumour: grey hat fines

rumour.legion_merger.text: Three corporate legions, one pilot shortage. Everyone at the bar has an opinion about which logo will survive the merger.
rumour.legion_merger.title: Rumour: legion merger

rumour.your_registry.text: Someone swears a hauler docked at Gamma with your registry, one digit off. Probably nothing.
rumour.your_registry.title: Rumour: your registry

rumour.miners_out.text: The Gamma miners are still out. Someone keeps shipping them sheet music.
rumour.miners_out.title: Rumour: miners out

rumour.first_mark.text: At the next table a man bites a Mark to check it. It has your registry on it. He looks at you and puts it away.
rumour.first_mark.title: Rumour: first mark

rumour.mraz_free.text: People say {pirate_captain.short} has a new ship and an old grudge. Not against you, oddly.
rumour.mraz_free.title: Rumour: mraz free

rumour.towers_hum.text: The relay towers at Barnard's Star hum at night. The farmers say the harvesters hum back.
rumour.towers_hum.title: Rumour: towers hum

rumour.sterilisation.text: A legion cruiser left for Sigma VII with sterilisation gear. Nobody at the bar will drink to it.
rumour.sterilisation.title: Rumour: sterilisation

rumour.lyra_again.text: Someone else heard the chirps from Lyra. Someone always does.
rumour.lyra_again.title: Rumour: lyra again

rumour.pellet_collector.text: The bartender asks whether you still have that heavy pellet. A collector was asking. From where, he did not say.
rumour.pellet_collector.title: Rumour: pellet collector

rumour.yesterday.text: The bartender serves you the drink you ordered yesterday. You were not here yesterday.
rumour.yesterday.title: Rumour: yesterday

rumour.famous_coffee.text: Your ship was famous for four days on the fluencer feeds, mostly for the coffee machine.
rumour.famous_coffee.title: Rumour: famous coffee
